expire_at_in_days.description: Number of days until maturity from today. Default: 7

cancel.description: Cancel the boleto that is being duplicated. Default: true

with_fines.description: Update the new boleto amount with interest and fine. Default: false

bank_billet_account_id.description: Collection wallet ID. If not provided, it will use the default wallet.

customer_id.description: Customer ID. When this ID is passed, the fields `customer_person_name`, `customer_cnpj_cpf`, `customer_zipcode`, `customer_address`, `customer_city_name`, `customer_state` and `customer_neighborhood` are not required.

customer_city_name.description: City (Name must be correct and complete)

customer_phone_number.description: Phone (with area code, international code is optional)

customer_ignore_email.description: Never send email to this customer

customer_ignore_sms.description: Never send SMS to this customer

customer_nickname.description: Nickname or trade name of the payer

interest_type.description:
Interest/penalty type:
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For daily percentage
* `2` For daily amount

days_for_interest.description: Number of days after the due date when the penalty will start to accrue. The default value is 1 day (the day after the due date).

interest_percentage.description: Daily interest percentage. From 0.0 to 100.0 (Ex 1.5% = 1.5) Required if interest_type equals 1.

interest_value.description: Daily interest amount (R$). Required if interest_type equals 2.

interest_days_type.description:
Type of days for interest:
* `0` Calendar
* `1` Business

fine_type.description:
Fine type:
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For percentage of boleto amount
* `2` For fixed amount

days_for_fine.description: Number of days after the due date when the fine will start to accrue. The default value is 1 day (the day after the due date).

fine_percentage.description: Late fee percentage Ex: 2% x R$ 250.00 = R$ 5.00. Required if fine_type equals 1

fine_value.description: Fine amount (R$). Required if fine_type equals 2.

discount_type.description:
Discount type:
The discount type will be the same for all three discounts, if they exist. :
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For fixed amount
* `2` For percentage of boleto amount

days_for_discount.description: Days for discount. Required if discount_type is different from 0 (zero)

discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the discount. Required if discount_type equals 2

discount_value.description: Discount amount (R$). Required if discount_type equals 1.

second_discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the second discount.

third_discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the third discount.

charge_type.description:
Charge type:
* `1` Simple
* `2` Linked
* `3` Discounted
* `4` Vendor

dispatch_type.description:
Charge type:
When the boleto needs to be sent by mail. It is necessary to contract the service with the bank and you will pay a fee.
* `1` Customer
* `2` Bank

guarantor_city_name.description: City (Name must be correct and complete) of final beneficiary (Drawer/Guarantor)

* `11` | `NCR` | Rural Credit Note
* `12` | `NP` | Promissory note
* `13` | `NPR` | Rural Promissory note
* `14` | `TM` | Commercial Triplicata
* `15` | `TS` | Service Triplicata
* `16` | `NS` | Insurance Note
* `17` | `RC` | Receipt
* `18` | `FAT` | Invoice
* `19` | `ND` | Debit Note
* `20` | `AP` | Insurance Policy

* `22` | `PC` | Consortium Installment
* `23` | `NF` | Nota Fiscal

our_number.description: Our Number. If not provided, it will use the Next Our Number from the Collection Wallet.

processed_our_number.description: Our Number calculated with check digit (formatted)

processed_our_number_raw.description: Our Number calculated with check digit (clean)

days_for_revoke.description:
Calendar days for withdrawal/return:

                  Null/Blank: Follows the bank's default.
                  0: Withdrawal/Return on the same day as maturity.
                  1 or more: Withdrawal/Return after maturity (Maturity + X calendar days).

days_for_negativation.description:
Calendar days for negative registry:

Available only for the following banks and formats.

* Bank |	CNAB 240|	CNAB 400 |Webservice
* Bradesco |	Yes |	Yes	| No
* Itaú | No | Yes | No

days_for_sue_type.description:
Type of days for protest:
                * `0` Calendar
                * `1` Business

sue_code.description: Protest code (CNAB 240). Check the possible values for each bank.

revoke_code.description: Withdrawal code (CNAB 240). Check the possible values for each bank.

first_instruction.description: First instruction (CNAB 400). Check the possible values for each bank.

second_instruction.description: Second instruction (CNAB 400). Check the possible values for each bank.

divergent_payment_type.description:
Type of divergent payment:
Valid only for Itaú and Caixa.
* `1` Accepts any divergent amount
* `2` Accepts payments within a range of amounts or percentages
* `3` Does not accept divergent amount payments
* `4` Accepts payments above a minimum amount or percentage

divergent_payment_value_type.description:
Type of value to consider for payment limits:
Valid only for Itaú and Caixa.
* `1` Reports divergent payments by amounts
* `2` Reports divergent payments by percentages

divergent_payment_maximum_value.description: Minimum value for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_minimum_value.description: Maximum value for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_maximum_percentage.description: Minimum percentage for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_minimum_percentage.description: Maximum percentage for divergent payment range.

divergent_payment_limit.description: Number of payments allowed. Required if divergent payment data is provided. Used only by Caixa.

prevent_registration.description:
Prevent sending registration to bank:

If `true`, prevents the boleto from being registered. To be used in cases where the boleto was already registered outside of Kobana but you want to include it in the system.

control_number.description:
Control number:

May contain any information of interest to the Company. The information contained in this field will always be returned with the respective title in the return file.

ignore_email.description: Do not send this boleto by email

ignore_sms.description: Never send this boleto by SMS

ignore_whatsapp.description: Never send this boleto by WhatsApp

custom_data.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format.

meta.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format.

custom_attachment_name.description: Name to be used in boleto files sent to the customer in notifications. Accepts use of variables. If left empty, the default is the word "boleto" followed by the ID.

split_payment.description:
Payment split.
Valid only for ABC Brasil (CNAB 240 remittance), Itaú and Bradesco (CNAB 400 remittance).
If true, the boleto split will be registered.
Provide the split accounts in `split_accounts`

split_payment_type.description:
Type of payment split:
Valid only for Itau. Used only with Payment split true.
* `1` Credit split by percentage (%) – Nominal value of the title
* `2` Credit split in amount (R$) – Nominal value of the title
* `3` Credit split by percentage (%) – Net amount received
* `4` Credit split in amount (R$) – Net amount received, split proportionally

floating.description: Number of Days for Credit. Default 5 days. Maximum 30 days.

financial_provider_external_id.description: Santander sharing code (2 digits, pre-registered in the agreement). When informed, the recipient's bank details are waived.

created_via_api.description: Indicates if the boleto was created by API

updated_at.description: Boleto last update date and time

payment_count.description: Number of partial payments accepted for this boleto.

carne_url.description: URL for viewing the voucher (When it is an installment)

formats.description: URLs with available formats. Ex.: PDF, Image, Pix etc

pix_enabled.description: Indicates if the boleto is hybrid and has Pix QR code

status.description:
Boleto status:
* `generating` Generating
* `draft` Draft
* `generation_failed` Generation failed
* `opened` Open
* `canceled` Canceled
* `paid` Paid
* `overdue` Overdue
* `validation_failed` Invalid
* `chargeback` Charged back

body.description: Sending any other billet parameter is allowed.
